paragraph: She cooked us a wonderful **meal**. This **meal** fills me up. My stomach hurts after **meals**.
english: food that is prepared and eaten

paragraph: Judging by the **photograph**, this was an adult male. I want this **photograph** developed as soon as possible. This **photograph** is more than one hundred years old.
english: a picture created by projecting an image onto a photosensitive surface such as a chemically treated plate or film, CCD receptor, etc

paragraph: Do you know how to get the **motor** started? Figure seven shows all the parts of the **motor**. This machine is driven by a small electric **motor**.
english: a machine or device that converts other energy forms into mechanical energy, or imparts motion

paragraph: Man is also an animal in a **broad** sense. His **broad** interests bring him **broad** views on everything. He was strong, with **broad** shoulders and dark eyes.
english: wide; also general

paragraph: There is a **strange** man in front of the house. Where did he get those **strange**-looking shoes? Sometimes he can be a **strange** guy.
english: not normal
arabicDesc: مثال: هناك رجل غريب أمام المنزل.

other.meaning: not yet part of one’s experience

paragraph: The street was full of **advertising**. The company will **advertise** its new product on television. I think I will **advertise** in the paper.
english: to tell people about a product or event to sell it

paragraph: We are facing a violent **crisis**. Can you handle this **crisis**? The financial **crisis** affected all parts of the economy.
english: unstable situation in political, social, economic or military affairs

paragraph: He entered the national high school boxing **championship** competition. He was elected the best player in the **championship**. The team was filled with the love of **championship**.
english: a competition to find the best player or team

paragraph: You need to **demonstrate** high-quality work. Would you **demonstrate** the next problem at the board? He went on to **demonstrate** how to use the machine.
english: to show how to use (something)
arabicDesc: مثال: عليك أن تقدم عملا ذو جودة عالية.

paragraph: She **attracted** me at first sight. She was always **attracted** to men who were much older than her. Some young women are **attracted** to gang members because it looks exciting to them.
english: pull without touching
arabicDesc: مثال: لقد جذبتني من النظرة الأولى .

paragraph: They checked how **pure** the water was. The water of this spring is **pure**. The air by the sea is **pure** and healthy.
english: free of flaws or imperfections

other.meaning: free of foreign material or pollutants

paragraph: He didn't agree to my **proposal**. She turned down my **proposal**. His **proposal** started a debate that lasted a year.
english: that which is proposed

other.meaning: the act of proposing a marriage

paragraph: His **index** finger is shorter than his ring finger. The price **index** hit an all-time high. Her **index** and ring fingers are exactly the same length.
english: an alphabetical listing of items and their location

paragraph: A horse! A horse! My **kingdom** for a horse! The queen ruled the **kingdom** instead of the king. This book deals with life in the United **Kingdom**.
english: a realm having a king or queen as its actual or nominal sovereign

paragraph: We are expecting the **experiment** to produce results. Let's try a small **experiment**. I'm like that as well. I like to **experiment**.
english: to conduct an experiment
arabicDesc: مثال: نحن نتوقّع من التّجربة أن تحدث نتائج.

paragraph: It looks like we fell into a **trap**. This road is a death **trap**. He thought he was smart, but he didn't realize that he fell in my **trap**.
english: trick or arrangement designed to catch someone in a more general sense
arabicDesc: مثال: يبدو أننا وقعنا في الفخ.

other.meaning: device designed to catch or kill animals

paragraph: There is an **orange** on the table. I am planting an **orange** tree. The sky started to turn **orange**.
english: an evergreen tree of the genus Citrus such as Citrus sinensis which yields oranges (the fruit)

other.meaning: Having the colour of the fruit of an orange tree (adjective)

paragraph: He paid no attention to my **warning**. The **warning** came too late. Couldn't you just let me off with a **warning**?
english: instance of warning someone
arabicDesc: مثال: لم يعر أي اهتمام لتحذيري.

paragraph: It won't take me long to **install** this software. Can you help me **install** it on my computer? There is not enough memory to **install** this software.
english: to connect, set up or prepare something for use

paragraph: This book is about a king who loses his **crown**. The **crown** is the top of the head. That book talks of a king who lost his **crown**.
english: royal headdress
arabicDesc: مثال: الكتاب عن ملك فقد تاجه.

other.meaning: topmost part of the head — see also scalp

paragraph: I wish I could go to the **concert**. Were there a lot of children at the **concert**? There were six people at the **concert** last week.
english: musical accordance or harmony
arabicDesc: مثال: ليتني كنت أستطيع الذهاب إلى الحفلة الغنائية.

other.meaning: a musical entertainment in which several voices or instruments take part

paragraph: The sales agent closed a major deal in **Asia**. Have you read the article about **Asia** in Time? Trade companies aim at a new market in **Asia**.
english: a daughter of Oceanus and Tethys, the wife of the Titan Iapetus, and mother of Atlas, Prometheus, Epimetheus and Menoetius

paragraph: Self **confidence** is the key to success. You need a balance of both **confidence** and fear. I do not put my complete **confidence** in him.
english: self-assurance

paragraph: There are **numerous** theories about the origin of life. Households with three children are **numerous** in the region. There were still **numerous** problems to be solved.
english: indefinitely large numerically

paragraph: What **specifically** are you looking for? What **specifically** do you need me to do? These flats are designed **specifically** for young families.
english: exactly; for a particular reason

paragraph: Would you run off **twenty** copies of his report? The vote was **twenty**-eight for and **twenty** against. Out of **twenty** students, only one has read the book.
english: cardinal number
arabicDesc: مثال: هل بإمكانك أن تنسخ لي عشرين نسخة من هذا التقرير؟

paragraph: More and more people are moving to **urban** areas. Our **urban** cats no longer need their hunting skills. I thought that it was just an **urban** legend.
english: of, pertaining to, characteristic of, or happening or located in, a city or town

paragraph: He is the last man to **submit** to authority. He had to **submit** himself to their decision. Where do you recommend I **submit** for publication?
english: to give a document or work to someone officially

paragraph: The term has a very loose **definition**. You can see that **definition** here, under sense three. What is the **definition** of development? Do you know?
english: statement of the meaning of a word or word group or a sign or symbol
arabicDesc: مثال: لا يملك هذا المصطلح تعريفا دقيقا.

paragraph: The **battery** in my phone has nearly run out. I couldn't phone you because my **battery** was flat. I need to replace the **battery** in my phone.
english: device storing electricity

paragraph: Your press conference has been **canceled**. If you're not ready at two, I'll **cancel** everything. I thought I told you to **cancel** that order.
english: invalidate, annul

paragraph: Look at those black **clouds**. The **cloud** was in the shape of a bear. There is a silver lining to every dark **cloud**!
english: a visible mass of water droplets suspended in the air
arabicDesc: مثال: أنظر إلى تلك الغيوم السوداء.

paragraph: Just do the **essential** repairs, please. Air is **essential** for life. These forms are **essential** for communication in any language.
english: necessary; very important
arabicDesc: مثال: فقط قم بالإصلاحات الضرورية, لو سمحت..

paragraph: My father and my brother work in this **factory**. China is the **factory** of the world. This building is not a **factory**.
english: manufacturing place
arabicDesc: مثال: يعمل أبي وأخي في هذا المصنع.

paragraph: On holidays, the number of **suicides** increases. Our organization aims to prevent **suicides**. **Suicides** of high school students as a result of bullying continued one after another.
english: the act of intentionally killing oneself

paragraph: Don't forget to add a little **salt**. I don't like swimming in **salt** water. Can you hand me the **salt**?
english: sodium chloride
arabicDesc: مثال: لا تنس أن تضيف قليلا من الملح.

paragraph: The **mayor** presented him with the key to the city. Among the guests were the **mayor** and his wife. It's said that the **mayor** is on the take.
english: the elected leader of a city or town
arabicDesc: مثال: قدم له العمدة مفتاح المدينة.

paragraph: When was the last time you rode a **bike**? My father goes to work by **bike**. I may be old, but I can still ride a **bike**.
english: a bicycle or motorcycle
arabicDesc: مثال: متى كانت آخر مرة ركبت بها دراجة هوائية ؟

paragraph: I want to **explore** something that is not common. There is a lot to **explore** in the area. One can **explore** and explain only that which exists.
english: to examine or investigate something systematically

paragraph: This is a long-held **tradition** in our family. Just because something is **tradition** doesn't mean it's right. This **tradition** has been passed down from generation to generation.
english: a commonly held system

paragraph: Where did you buy that **hat** you were wearing yesterday? I forget where I put my **hat**. My father bought this **hat** for me.
english: a head covering
arabicDesc: مثال: أين اشتريت تلك القبّعة التي كنت ترتديها البارحة؟

paragraph: His opinions and ideas changed my **perspective** on life. What unique **perspective** do you bring to the table? We must see the matter in its proper **perspective**.
english: view, vista or outlook
arabicDesc: مثال: أراءه وأفكاره غيرت منظوري للحياة.

paragraph: I hope there is a **resolution** of this problem. My **resolution** was shaken when I heard about it. He made a firm **resolution** never to repeat it.
english: a firm decision or an official decision

other.meaning: formal statement adopted by an assembly

paragraph: He was locked up in the **tower** for months. The **tower** was seen clearly against the blue sky. I can see the **tower** from where I stand.
english: tall, narrow structure

paragraph: This drink will take you from **zero** to hero. We implemented a new marketing strategy at **zero** cost. I just want to **zero** in on this.
english: cardinal number before 1, denoting nothing

other.meaning: The numeric symbol that represents the cardinal number zero (noun)

paragraph: He gave **expression** to his ideas through his work. Crying is an **expression** for pain in the heart. I believe in freedom of **expression** in any way.
english: the action of expressing thoughts, ideas, feelings, etc

paragraph: This area is as big as a football **pitch**. Let's all **pitch** in and get the work done. How can I sing better at a high **pitch**?
english: a sticky, gummy substance secreted by trees

paragraph: I believe you have not yet made a **contribution**. He made a great **contribution** to research into cancer. I recognize your **contribution** to keeping the kitchen clean.
english: something given or offered that adds to a larger whole

paragraph: There are twenty-five students in the **assembly** hall. I don't want to work on an **assembly** line. The **assembly** consisted of people concerned about human rights.
english: a set of pieces that work together in unison as a mechanism or device

paragraph: You must **observe** the law. We like to **observe** birds. It is necessary that every member **observe** these rules.
english: to notice, to watch — see also notice

paragraph: Thanks to the development of **aircraft**, the world has become much smaller. It takes a lot to sink an **aircraft** carrier. China has the means to destroy your **aircraft** carriers.
english: machine capable of atmospheric flight
arabicDesc: مثال: بفضل تطوير الطيران, العالم أصبح أصغر بكثير.

paragraph: **Approximately** how much money should I take with me? **Approximately** how many hours does it take by car? It's better to be **approximately** right than completely wrong.
english: imprecise but close to in quantity or amount

paragraph: Improving **corporate** performances are behind the stock market recovery. I want to build my **corporate** site to attract customers. I am going to a **corporate** event.
english: relating to a large company

paragraph: His boss is **friendly**, he's American. He was very **friendly** to everybody. She is **friendly** to everybody.
english: approachable, warm

paragraph: If you can't eat **properly**, leave the table. Brush your teeth **properly** before going to bed. Allow me to **properly** introduce myself first.
english: in a proper manner, appropriately, suitably
arabicDesc: مثال: إن لم تستطع الأكل بالطريقة الصحيحة، فغادر الطاولة.

paragraph: How much of the apple **layer** cake is left? I suggest that you wear an extra **layer**. She added a **layer** of cream between the cake **layers**.
english: single thickness of some material covering a surface

paragraph: Do you have enough **wire**? What color are the **wires**? If you touch that **wire**, you'll get a shock.
english: thin thread of metal
arabicDesc: مثال: هل لديك ما يكفي من السلك؟

paragraph: The force of the water powers the **mill** wheel. The coffee **mill** that I received does not work. Incidents such as these are run-of-the-**mill**.
english: a grinding apparatus for substances such as grains, seeds, etc. (Some are small and simple, and some are large and complex.)

other.meaning: To grind or otherwise process in a mill or other machine (verb)

paragraph: The **journalist** was fired because he wrote the truth. The **journalist** reported each new development in the talks. The **journalist** rented an apartment that is very expensive.
english: the keeper of a personal journal, who writes in it regularly

paragraph: This is kind of a special **circumstance**. What would you do in this **circumstance**? She's just a victim of **circumstance**.
english: something which is related to, or in some way affects, a fact or event

paragraph: **Delivery** of goods occurs a month after the order is placed. The new employee is in charge of mail **delivery**. Would you please let me know the **delivery** time?
english: act of conveying something
arabicDesc: مثال: تسليم البضاعة يتم بعد شهر من تسجيل الطلب.

paragraph: The result of the **poll** will be known soon. The results of our opinion **poll** permit some interesting conclusions. The opinion **poll** was based on a random sample of adults.
english: a survey of people's opinions; also voting

paragraph: Can I have a **portion** of the leg, please? He has not paid his **portion** of the rent. Would you like a whole or half **portion**?
english: an allocated amount

paragraph: There are a lot of things you don't know about my **personality**. Each cat has its own **personality**. She has a wonderful **personality**.
english: of people, a set of non-physical psychological and social qualities that make one person distinct from another
arabicDesc: مثال: هناك الكثير من الأمور التي لا تعرفها عن شخصيتي.

paragraph: The **flood** caused a lot of damage. The **flood** water reached the level of the windows. They want to **flood** the market with cheap products.
english: overflow of water

other.meaning: The flood referred to in the Book of Genesis in the Hebrew Bible (noun)

paragraph: Which ice **cream** shop are you going to? I don't like **cream** in my coffee. He likes your ice **cream** so much.
english: product to apply to the skin
arabicDesc: مثال: أي مَحَل مثلجات أنتَ ذاهب إليه؟

paragraph: The box was completely **sealed**. Please be sure to sign and **seal** the form. I think that we're ready to **seal** the deal.
english: a pinniped (Pinnipedia), particularly an earless seal (true seal) or eared seal

paragraph: My children are a **blessing**. **Bless** me, Father, for I have sinned or will sin. **Bless** you for all your good works.
english: to make something holy by religious rite, sanctify

paragraph: And they saw the new **heaven** and new earth. You're as different from me as **heaven** and earth. Your will be done on Earth as in **Heaven**.
english: the abode of God or the gods, traditionally conceived as beyond the sky

paragraph: What are the different parts of an **academic** paper? Teaching is one of the jobs an **academic** does. It seems to be a matter of **academic** dispute.
english: scholarly; literary or classical, in distinction from vocational

other.meaning: conforming to set rules and traditions
A follower of Plato, a Platonist (noun)

paragraph: Our goal is to win the **tournament** this year. Who is the defending champion of this **tournament**? Who do you think will win the **tournament**?
english: a competition with many games

paragraph: I'm not exactly sure how to **implement** this plan. The idea is good, but it's difficult to **implement**. Unfortunately, we couldn't **implement** much of what was planned.
english: to bring about

paragraph: My mother is on a **diet**. Above all, watch your **diet**. We're going to eat a lot tonight so I hope you're not on a **diet**.
english: food a person or animal consumes

paragraph: Waking up is the **opposite** of going to sleep. I can't say the **opposite**. It isn't what you say, but just the **opposite**.
english: located directly across from

other.meaning: of complementary or mutually exclusive things

paragraph: Put a **tag** on the pages you want copied. The dog that we found didn't have a **tag**. Items with a red price **tag** are on sale.
english: physical appendage

paragraph: The kitchen island provides extra **counter** space for cooking. That was his field, so how could I **counter**? He was sitting all by himself at the **counter**.
english: one who counts

paragraph: She was busy with **household** work. Our **household** expense got into the red last month. They divorced, but they live in the same **household**.
english: all the people who live in one home

paragraph: Unlike the brain, the stomach alerts you when it is **empty**. The train station was pretty **empty**. The bus is pretty **empty**.
english: devoid of content
arabicDesc: مثال: .‏على عكس الدماغ ، تنبهك المعدة عندما تكون فارغة

paragraph: He did his best to **rescue** her. He ran into the burning house to **rescue** her. The **rescue** team never found the four missing girls.
english: act of rescuing, saving
arabicDesc: مثال: لقد قام بما في وسعه لانقاذها.

paragraph: I'll work day and night and won't **complain**. Women don't like men who **complain** about money. I'm going to **complain** to the manager.
english: to express feelings of pain, dissatisfaction, or resentment
arabicDesc: مثال: سأعمل ليلا، نهارا، و لن أشتكي.

other.meaning: to make a formal accusation or bring a formal charge

paragraph: He went traveling in search of **adventure**. I was very happy to start a new **adventure**. What kind of **adventure** do you want to have?
english: remarkable occurrence

other.meaning: mercantile or speculative enterprise of hazard

paragraph: I want to be your **ally**, not your enemy. An enemy of an enemy isn't necessarily an **ally**. The night is her **ally**, quiet and sure.
english: a person who co-operates with or helps another

paragraph: The house is big, but the garden is **tiny**. His **tiny** hands explored every corner of the house. Our house is **tiny**, but I love it.
english: very small

paragraph: Better to go **solo** than to be in bad company. Have you been on a **solo** trip before? Now that my only colleague has retired, I'm flying **solo**.
english: done alone

paragraph: He often walks with his hand in his **pocket**. I have very small apples in my **pocket**. He took a key from his coat **pocket**.
english: bag stitched to an item of clothing
arabicDesc: مثال: عادة ما يمشي و يده في جيبه.

paragraph: We have an **extreme** amount of respect for him. I only do it in cases of **extreme** emergency. He uses **extreme** care when he drives in the rain.
english: of a place, the most remote, farthest or outermost

other.meaning: in the greatest or highest degree; intense
excessive, or far beyond the norm

paragraph: He was **basically** on his phone the entire time. **Basically** she wasn't able to speak English in real life. I suddenly realized that I **basically** knew nothing about him.
english: in a fundamental, essential or basic manner

paragraph: **Besides** making the plan, my brother carried it out. It's too late now. **Besides**, it's starting to rain. The parking lot was empty **besides** two other cars.
english: in addition to

paragraph: The channel has had to apologize for its biased **coverage**.
english: an amount by which something or someone is covered

paragraph: You should know. You're far more **experienced** than me. I have seen it all and **experienced** it all. You're way more **experienced** than I am, aren't you?
english: having skill from doing something for a long time

paragraph: I'll write a negative comment from a **false** account. It is **false** to say that snow is blue. It's hard to tell what's true and what's **false**.
english: untrue, not factual, factually incorrect

paragraph: It was an **incredible** job. The concert was an **incredible** experience that everyone loved. What an **incredible** amount of work he has done!
english: very good or hard to believe

paragraph: It's so **obvious** that it's a lie! This is so **obvious** that people can't realize it. It's **obvious** that it can't go on like this.
english: easily discovered or understood; self-explanatory
arabicDesc: مثال: كم هو واضح أنها كذبة!

paragraph: Could you please speak a little bit more **slowly**? Please speak **slowly**, so I can understand you. **Slowly**, the stars filled the sky.
english: at a slow pace
arabicDesc: مثال: أيمكنك أن تتحدث ببطئ من فضلك؟

paragraph: We must finish everything before **Tuesday** morning. Next Monday and **Tuesday** are holidays. She pushed back the meeting from Monday to **Tuesday**.
english: day of the week
arabicDesc: مثال: يجب علينا إنهاء كل شيء قبل صباح الثلاثاء.

paragraph: Do you know how **worried** you made me? I am **worried** about his health. It has **worried** me a lot.
english: thinking about unpleasant things that have happened or that might happen
arabicDesc: مثال: هل تعلم كم قلقت عليك؟

paragraph: In other words, she wants to **reject** the proposal. I do not want to **reject** this claim. It should be a crime for her to **reject** you.
english: to refuse to accept

paragraph: If you think about, everyone is already a **statistic**. That **statistic** is completely made up. Don't trust any **statistics** you did not fake yourself.
english: a single item in a statistical study

paragraph: When will this machine be put in **motion** again? I want to see the scene in slow **motion**. Don't get off while the vehicle is in **motion**.
english: a change whereby something goes from one place to another
arabicDesc: مثال: متى ستشغل هذه الآلة مجددا؟

paragraph: No one knows when such a **custom** first came into existence. Each country has its own **customs**. We should do away with such a bad **custom**.
english: frequent repetition of the same act
arabicDesc: مثال: لا أحد يعلم متى ظهرت هذه العادة.
